findings.highlight: Being able to land a hit on my mentor is like proof of my growing skill.
findings.evidenceJa: そのお師匠様から一本とれるなんて、皆伝を与えられたようなもんなんだから。
findings.governingReading: Getting one hit on his teacher would be like receiving the complete transmission of the art, a hyperbolic graduation/mastery accolade.
findings.explanation: A full-mastery comparison becomes generic growing skill.
